Uttar Pradesh Government Transfers 15 IPS Officers

The Uttar Pradesh government has transferred 15 Indian Police Service (IPS) officers. Additionally, in a separate administrative reshuffling, six joint secretaries who received promotions have been reassigned to new departments within the secretariat. The transfers and reassignments indicate a significant administrative change within the state government.
